description: Cast the old, Embrace the new.9
summary:
REDHAVEN: is a story-driven browser game for ages 7–12 that turns space mission design into play. Before launch, players choose a mission priority (Dependable Shelter, First Garden or Signal Home), a carrier, a landing site, a launch profile and an optional payload. Everything has to fit within mass, budget and power limits, and only 125 of 288 possible loadouts pass. After a short launch-to-landing timeline, players run an unfinished Mars outpost for ten mission days. They repair the habitat, tend a greenhouse, shelter through a solar-storm drill, and work around delayed messages from Earth until a rover arrives.

REDHAVEN answers the Space Mission Design Game challenge by covering a whole mission, from concept to operations to evaluation. Every choice made before launch changes what is possible on Mars. A final mission report traces each outcome back to the decision behind it.
details:
REDHAVEN: is a single-player browser game for ages 7–12. It has three phases.

Design the mission. At the Mission Design Desk, players choose:

a mission priority: Dependable Shelter, First Garden or Signal Home. Each one comes with its own science instrument.

a carrier: Battery, Life-Support or Construction.

a landing site: Open Plain or Crater Ridge.

a launch profile: Compact Rideshare or Enhanced Lift.

a budget: Standard (24 credits) or Lean (20 credits).

up to one optional payload.

A live manifest checks the plan’s mass, credits, connector compatibility and starting power. If a plan fails, the game shows the exact numbers and how to fix it. Only 125 of the 288 possible loadouts pass.

Launch and arrive. A short, labeled timeline shows launch, the trip to Mars and the landing.

Survive ten mission days. Mika the engineer, Sol the botanist and Pip the maintenance robot must keep everyone alive at an unfinished outpost until a transport rover arrives. Commander Reyes advises them from Mission Control on Earth.

Each day, players send power to the oxygen recycler and choose one task, such as repairing the habitat, recovering a supply crate, tending the greenhouse or bracing the shelter.

The game shows the exact resources the day will end with before the player confirms.

Scripted events test the plan: a solar-storm shelter drill, a chance to change the mission goal, a harvest, a beacon to guide the incoming rover, and a battery fault that an earlier inspection can prevent.
